title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S17, outside data: winrates, tiers and the past
thread:
**Issue #3538 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3538: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S17, outside data: winrates, tiers and the past
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the cards that read data from outside the match (winrates, tiers and past versions), and xxFreshJack's BUSTED as one general function.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #33 | True Conservative |
| #34 | Neoconservative |
| #95 | JC Backed |
| #96 | Open Enrollment |
| #97 | Selective Enrollment |
| #164 | KPIs (the list's second #93) |
| S #109 | (xxFreshJack: BUSTED from winrates over every patch) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- Stinkyscape's M12 card metrics, BUSTED and complicated cards (`crates/cards/src/history.rs`, R1846003, #2173's per-version lists)
- the older shipped catalogs (R767000) and `patches.json`
- E9 (random cards are unique, the owner's system change): every random card in an effect is unique unless the pool runs out. E9 lands after this part, so don't build uniqueness here; the release re-pins any seed-pinned test it moves.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- Data reaches a pure crate only at compile time (CLAUDE.md rule 4): winrates and tiers come from the card metrics snapshot the cards crate already includes, refreshed by tooling in `crates/tools`, never read at run time.
- xxFreshJack: BUSTED is one function (in `crates/cards` or `crates/tools`, writing the compiled list) that ranks every card of every shipped version by its winrate of record, past patches included. No hand-kept list needs upkeep each patch. A shipped version keeps its own list (#2173), so replays fold under the list of their version. xxFreshJack's change plays differently, so the release's fragment claims it.
- #164 KPIs: renumbered from the second #93 (SP5). "Lower winrate than this" compares the card metrics' winrate of record. **A card with no recorded winrate counts as 50%** (the owner, 2026-11-09), and so does KPIs itself when it has none.
- #95 to #97: S, A, D and F are the card metrics' tiers of record. #96 and #97 lose "unique" from their text (SP5): uniqueness is now every random card's rule (E9). "Fill your hand" adds until `HAND_LIMIT`. JC Backed's "lose 1 mana for the rest of the game" is the base face's only. Its Jlarna is the existing token.
- #33 True Conservative: "a version from their Past" is the card's entry in an older shipped catalog. A card with none is untouched. Several past versions: a random one. The Radiant face makes yours the strongest (**default**: the highest stat total, then the highest cost).
- #34 Neoconservative: a Jlockeed card from a past version, from the same catalogs.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
(xxFreshJack, from the designer's balance changes:)
* **xxFreshJack**
  * BUSTED cards include cards from past patches too.
  * Should use winrates when evaluating what’s busted.
  * Create a general function for figuring out what’s BUSTED so this doesn’t have to be maintained every update.

**(4) True Conservative, Unit, Human, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #33**
3/3
**Cry:** Transform ALL Units into a version from their Past.
{For AI: look in the patch notes. If a card doesn’t have a past version, it’s untouched}
~~~
6/6
**Cry:** Transform ALL Units into a version from their Past. Yours become their strongest version.

**(2) Neoconservative, Unit, Human, Common, Stinkyscape+, #34**
5/3
**Cry**: Add a Jlockeed card from the past to your hand.
~~~
10/6
**Cry**: Add a Radiant Jlockeed card from the past to your hand.

**(3) JC Backed, Spell, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #95**
Fill your hand with random S tier {or A tier if no S exist} cards. Summon 2 **Jlarna** and lose 1 mana for the rest of the game.
~~~
Fill your hand with random S tier {or A tier if no S exist} cards. Summon 2 Radiant **Jlarna** for the rest of the game.

**(2) Open Enrollment, Spell, Common, Stinkyscape+, #96**
Fill your hand with random unique F tier {or D tier if no F exist} cards.
~~~
Fill your hand with random unique Radiant F tier {or D tier if no F exist} cards.

**(4) Selective Enrollment, Spell, Common, Stinkyscape+, #97**
Fill your hand with random unique Radiant S tier {or A tier if no S exist} cards.
~~~
Fill your hand with random unique Radiant S tier {or A tier if no S exist} cards, they cost (2) less.

**(2) KPIs, Spell, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #93**
Destroy every card with a lower winrate than this.
~~~
Destroy every enemy card with a lower winrate than this.
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9), the 50% default winrate among them. A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3535

Part of #3534.
````
